structured.answer: Open an account at Psagot (פסגות) and buy the אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125 fund. With the page's 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years, it says I'd end up with about 86,045 ₪ after fees and tax, in today's money.

stuck.where: Amount fields on screen 1 (סכום היום 10,000, הפקדה חודשית 500)
stuck.why: The task gave no amounts, so I wasn't sure whether to put in my 30,000. I left the defaults.
Every fund has a minus percent (−0.04%, −0.37%...) and I couldn't tell if that means losing money.

stuck.where: The colour bar under 'כמה זה עולה לכם' on screen 2
stuck.why: The colours were only explained further down, so I guessed the pink part was tax.

findings.what: Minus percent on every fund including the recommended one looks like the fund loses money
Ending with 86k from 70k deposited at 7% felt low; 'בכסף של היום' is easy to miss
Colour bar meaning only explained after scrolling, small legend
Lots of jargon (דמי משמרת, נאמן, 4A) with no plain explanation
No clear next step / how to open the account
Big gaps between houses (23k+ costs at Altshuler, Meitav) look scary without explanation
